findings.Fix: tighten to his specific tactical reasoning rather than a universal claim about 'a man'

findings.Quote: this room had a number in it he recognized
findings.Note: slightly vague/abstract phrasing for what should be a concrete deduction; trades clarity for a moody flourish
findings.Fix: specify what the number means to him rather than gesturing at recognition

findings.Quote: Someone would open the locker eventually and stand looking at what was in it. But eventually was a different problem, and it would belong to a different afternoon, not to him.
findings.Note: Slightly overwritten deflection-of-consequence riff; states the theme rather than trusting the image.
findings.Fix: Cut the second sentence and let the first stand alone.

findings.Quote: He had not known its shape. He had known there would be one.
findings.Note: Reads as a pat aphoristic flourish rather than earned insight — slightly too neat/quotable for the moment.
findings.Fix: Fold into plainer statement, e.g. 'He hadn't known when it would come, only that it would.'

findings.Quote: learned, step by step, the weight of carrying himself unpowered, and found that he could
findings.Note: Tells the emotional/physical realization directly instead of dramatizing it; borders on pseudo-profound summary.
findings.Fix: Show a concrete physical detail of the strain/adjustment instead of naming the lesson.

findings.Quote: It happened by degrees, the way those things do.
findings.Note: Vague filler opener that tells rather than shows the transition, and the tautological phrasing ('the way those things do') is a soft hedge rather than a concrete image.
findings.Fix: Cut the sentence or replace with a specific sensory marker of the transition.

findings.Quote: Relief was for men who had been afraid, and he had spent his fear years ago, on a morning at Cortland, in a currency that did not come back.
findings.Note: The 'fear as currency that did not come back' metaphor gestures at profundity without holding up literally — fear isn't spent like money in a way that explains why relief is now unavailable to him.
findings.Fix: Ground the claim in a concrete consequence of Cortland rather than an abstract currency metaphor.

findings.Quote: He looked for the institution in himself and found it gone. He let the strangeness be a fact.
findings.Note: Tells the reader his internal state abstractly ('let the strangeness be a fact') instead of dramatizing it.
findings.Fix: Replace with a concrete physical or behavioral detail showing the absence.

findings.Quote: like he was worth looking at, which he was
findings.Note: Authorial aside that asserts a judgment directly rather than letting the clerk's reaction carry it — mild telling-not-showing.
findings.Fix: Cut the clause 'which he was' and let the clerk's reaction stand alone.

findings.Quote: He had never in his life left food on a plate; you do not, when you have spent time in places where there was not any.
findings.Note: Sudden shift to second-person 'you' reads as an inserted aphorism/universal-truth aside rather than character-grounded narration.
findings.Fix: Keep it in third person tied to Bear specifically, e.g. 'He had learned not to, in places where there wasn't any.'

findings.Quote: he felt the absence answer back, which was its own kind of company
findings.Note: Paradox-as-wisdom line that reads as a turn of phrase rather than an earned observation; slightly purple.
findings.Fix: Cut the clause after the comma, or make the sensation more concrete.

findings.Quote: and believed the kid would, a little, because somebody large had bothered to say it
findings.Note: Sentimental telling-not-showing flourish that softens the scene with unearned warmth.
findings.Fix: Cut or replace with a concrete detail/action instead of stated belief.

findings.Quote: The new room was identical to the old one in every way that mattered, which was none of them.
findings.Note: Clever-sounding paradox construction that doesn't clarify anything concrete about the room or his state.
findings.Fix: Replace with one or two specific sensory details establishing the room's sameness/difference.

findings.Quote: fed and aged and exercised in small honest amounts, so that it read like a life instead of a forgery, which was the whole point of building a thing three years before you needed it
findings.Note: clause stacks explanatory tail onto tail, telling the reader the point instead of trusting the image already made
findings.Fix: cut the trailing 'which was the whole point...' clause; the metaphor already carries it

findings.Quote: He had always known what it was for.
findings.Note: vague portentous close-out line, asserts significance without giving content

findings.Quote: kept the number alive the way you keep a knife oiled

findings.Note: abstract, overwrought phrasing ('unprefixed,' 'owing nobody an account') that tips into telling the theme rather than rendering sound
findings.Fix: ground it in one or two concrete sonic details before or instead of the abstraction

findings.Quote: for the first time in eight years it sounded, to Boris Johansen, a great deal like home
findings.Note: the 'sounded like home' closing beat is a familiar sentimental cadence
findings.Fix: specify what particular quality made it feel that way, avoiding the stock 'like home' formulation

findings.Quote: the kind of quiet that isn't really quiet but a person deciding how much to tell you before you've told her anything
findings.Note: convoluted, self-canceling phrasing ('quiet that isn't really quiet') that obscures rather than sharpens the image
findings.Fix: simplify to a direct description of her guarded tone

findings.Quote: he read off his specs the way a man reads a menu aloud
findings.Note: simile is serviceable but generic filler comparison, doesn't add specific texture
findings.Fix: cut or replace with a more specific comparison tied to his character

findings.Note: Aphoristic distinction stated as revelation reads as a tidy thesis statement rather than an observation arising from character.
findings.Fix: Cut the explicit framing and let the distinction surface through his specific memory of her phrasing.

findings.Quote: a leash he'd stopped noticing he wore
findings.Note: Stock collar/leash-of-compliance imagery for corporate control.
findings.Fix: Replace with a more specific physical detail unique to the compliance lock's function.

findings.Quote: Nothing rose to meet them.
findings.Note: Vague gesture toward absence/loss that tells rather than shows the physical sensation.

findings.Note: Clever-sounding construction that doesn't quite parse literally — a decision can't be 'furnished,' and the metaphor doesn't clarify what he actually perceives.

findings.Quote: knew it from Hana Morimoto, from every careful person who'd ever sat across a table and done the work instead of performing it
findings.Note: 'done the work instead of performing it' is a generalized aphorism that tells us the theme rather than showing the specific recognition; it universalizes into a stock distinction rather than staying grounded in this character's specific memory.
findings.Fix: Anchor it in a concrete memory beat instead of the abstract work/performance dichotomy.

findings.Quote: just proof that someone upstream had looked at him once and moved on
findings.Note: Slides into telling the reader the symbolic function of the password rather than trusting the scene's action to carry it; mildly explanatory after already showing the exchange.
findings.Fix: Trim to let the password's meaning stay implicit, or shorten to a clause.

findings.Quote: meant it, the way he meant it with everyone
findings.Note: Vague generalization that tells us about Bear's character rather than showing this specific moment land; softens the specificity of the beat.
findings.Fix: Cut the comparison and let the meaning sit in the delivery: "Take care of yourself," Bear told her anyway, and watched it land somewhere she plainly hadn't braced for.

findings.Quote: There was nothing on the other side of that door that was his to carry.
findings.Note: Reads as a tidy, aphoristic capstone that states the theme rather than dramatizing it — borders on pseudo-profound summary.
findings.Fix: Trim to action: He didn't look back at it, and kept walking.

findings.Quote: It was a relief to still be good at it.
findings.Note: Tells the emotion directly instead of letting the preceding detail carry it; redundant after the aphorism it follows.
findings.Fix: Cut the sentence; the prior image already implies the relief.

findings.Quote: an old habit that meant nothing

findings.Note: Cute self-canceling wordplay that states its own cleverness rather than landing as insight.

findings.Quote: as long as it managed it early, quietly, and warmly

findings.Fix: Replace 'warmly' with a concrete descriptor of Halcyon's tactic (e.g. 'without a hearing record').

findings.Quote: a sound like something breathing through cloth

findings.Quote: Two years of Hana's work, buried in a filing.
findings.Note: Summary-statement telling the reader the emotional stakes rather than letting the preceding facts carry it.

findings.Quote: fourteen days wasn't enough time to become the kind of man who needed one

findings.Quote: a reason he'd let himself sit with when the time came

findings.Quote: at the speed of nothing happening, until everything happened at once
findings.Note: Generic aphoristic description of institutional time; doesn't earn its place with specific texture.

findings.Quote: three truer, harder words

findings.Quote: she'd started to feel like the surveillance was the thing being tested, not the target

findings.Fix: Let the observation emerge through a concrete detail of her own conduct rather than a stated paradox.

findings.Quote: Halcyon was just going to be whoever walked in first.
findings.Note: Aphoristic capstone that states the theme rather than letting the blank room's implication stand on its own.

findings.Quote: So that whoever opened the locker had one full second to wonder what they were holding before the medal told them.

findings.Fix: Cut the sentence and end on the image of the decoration in her palm.

findings.Note: tells the reader how to interpret the pause rather than letting the dialogue beat itself convey it
